bio: Here at the Naturhotel Rebling, situated at an altitude of 610m, you can expect not only spectacular views of the region (with visibility up to 100km on a clear day), but also delicious cuisine imbued with seasonal flavours. Katharina and Erich Schwingshackl invite you to experience HEIMATKÜCHE, an appealing alternative to fine dining restaurant ESSKULTUR. Katharina manages the restaurant floor, providing friendly and attentive service, Erich cooks up dishes such as South Tyrolean Schlutzkrapfen (stuffed pasta) with brown hay-milk butter, or game ragout with organic egg spaetzle. The Wiener schnitzel is also to be recommended. You can opt for a four-course set menu or go à la carte.
